compiled_state.title: [hooks/lib/pre-bash-functions.sh]: hook_record_test_status_guard removal lacks ADR/decision record -> future contributors may re-add the guard thinking it was inadvertently removed
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Source
PR #72 llm-review run 25537710859, finding F6 (severity: minor, design).

### Expected Behavior
A non-trivial removal of a defense-in-depth guard (even a non-load-bearing one) should leave behind a written rationale for future contributors. The current placeholder at plugins/dso/hooks/lib/pre-bash-functions.sh (where hook_record_test_status_guard used to live) is brief: 5 lines pointing at the load-bearing diff_hash check. This is enough for a careful reviewer but not enough to prevent re-introduction.

### Actual Behavior
Bug ce62-624e was fixed in PR #72 by removing the guard function and its registration. The deletion comment is short. There is no ADR, no docs/decisions/ entry, and no expanded comment block explaining:
- Why the guard was added originally (a2e0-3ae8 lineage)
- Why it was non-load-bearing (where the load-bearing defense is)
- Why removal is safe (which tests cover the diff_hash path: test_gate_blocked_hash_mismatch in tests/hooks/test-pre-commit-test-gate.sh:194)
- The DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 sentinel cleanup that came with removal

### Suggested Fix
One of:
1. Add a docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-remove-record-test-status-guard.md entry capturing the four points above.
2. Expand the in-file deletion comment in pre-bash-functions.sh into a full block with explicit cross-references to the load-bearing defense and the regression-protection tests.

Option 2 is cheaper and keeps the rationale at the deletion site (highest-visibility location for someone considering re-adding the guard).

### Severity
P3: documentation/design refinement. No functional impact; protective against future regression.

### File / Line References
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/pre-bash-functions.sh — where hook_record_test_status_guard was removed
- plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/pre-bash.sh — the ce62-624e comment in the registration list
- tests/hooks/test-pre-commit-test-gate.sh:194 — load-bearing test (test_gate_blocked_hash_mismatch)

### Origin
Follow-up from PR #72.
